annotations.text:
Fixed window 1200×720 (JUCE, no resize in v0.1).

Left: 16 pads, MPC order (pad 1 bottom-left). Click = play (velocity by click height), drop audio = assign.

Middle: pad editor (note, RR/RND, choke, 6 knobs) + velocity layer editor: drag teal dividers, chips = samples in a layer.

Right: built-in browser. Single click = preview through plugin output when Preview toggle is on; double-click / drag = add to selected layer.
Save kit → picks a folder, copies every sample into <Kit>/samples/, writes kit.json with relative paths. Kit is fully portable between DAW projects.
